lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It goes to the labour board on a Thursday afternoon, in a folder, with four hundred and six names in alphabetical order.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nothing happens. The board notes it, files it, and publishes it, because publishing is what the board does with things it has decided not to act on.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Published. That's the whole point. It's in the record now and the record is the only thing that survives two hundred and eighty years.
